The Automated Starter and Leaver System

We build the automated starter and leaver system in your Microsoft 365 once. After that, a request goes in, the manager approves in Teams, and the system does the rest.

Who this is for

For firms hiring steadily

Firms where the owner or office manager still does every setup by hand.

When setups are manual, they take hours and steps get missed. When someone leaves, their access often lingers for weeks because closing it down is easy to forget.

A strong fit for regulated firms like law and accounting, where a leaver keeping access to client files is a real liability.

Automated Starter and Leaver System

Built once. Runs every starter and leaver.
